title: the WSG availability of medicinal plants slice with Table 40 - the terrain-climate vegetation and locate grids with the identify-half rule and the search discipline, printed p. 69
audit_label: R478 WSG medicinal plants pin audit
audit_comment: The Table 40 terrain-climate grids (34 rows: Arctic six with no swamp, then subarctic, temperate, subtropical and tropical with all seven terrains apiece), the slash entry semantics (the left number the vegetation chance, the right the locate chance, identify on one-half or less, the upper half a wrong type believed right), plant lore always correct, one search per turn while moving, repeated searches auto-fail, movement slowed, and the worked example (tropical hills winter 90 and 30: roll 15 the right type, 16-30 wrong, 31-up nothing).

banner.title: R478: the WSG MEDICINAL PLANTS slice, printed p. 69 - the eighth camping-arc round, a TABLE round pinning Table 40: the availability of medicinal plants as two 34-row grids (the vegetation chance and the locate chance, four seasons apiece) over the terrain-climate frame (D, F, H, M, P, Se and Sw - Arctic with no swamp row), plus the slash entry semantics, the identify-half rule, the plant-lore always-correct rule, the search discipline and the worked example citing Appendix J in the DMG at pages 220-221.
banner.provenance: The settle: the pdf layer DROPPED the entire leftmost terrain-code column and ALL five seacoast rows; tesseract kept the codes but garbled many slash cells (10110, 5110, 1510, 4010, 75140, 2010) and missed the seacoast rows plus the Arctic M row. Every contested cell was settled by targeted vision reads with two agreeing independent reads apiece (this round needed SEVEN reads); Arctic has no Sw row (six terrains, 34 rows total); and the book own worked example - tropical hills winter, vegetation 90 and locate 30 - independently confirms the settled row 29.
banner.sentinel: Bounds held by the grids: every vegetation chance stays in 0-100, every locate chance in 0-50; the identify cut is the locate chance halved.
